desc:
Baltic Bus Simulator puts you behind the wheel of real public transport across the Baltic region. Feel the weight of the bus and master every route. 🚌💨

⚠️ EARLY ACCESS: This game is in active development. Looking for a polished, bug-free experience? Hold off for now. Want to be part of the journey and help shape the game? Welcome aboard!

What to expect:
🚏 Drive your first route in Tartu, Estonia
🗺️ Explore a detailed 1:1 scale map
⚙️ Feel every turn with our realistic physics - custom suspension, handling, weight transfer & drivetrain
🎮 Xbox & PlayStation support, plus early mobile support
🌍 And more to discover!
✨ New updates on the way - this is just the beginning! ✨

Version: Early Access | Update 2
Join our community and help shape what comes next! 🚍

Made by Vision Development Interactive
